This results in additional CPU usage, as raising/lowering the pitch requires real-time processing of audio data.

Insufficient CPU resources will cause processing tasks to pile up, and a sound exception will occur.
At this time, it is necessary to pause the playback for a period of time and wait for the accumulated tasks to be processed before playing.
